## Diagnostic Report (Recommended)
If your mobile device connects but shows no conversation, fails to detect your IDE session, or disconnects unexpectedly, please run the built-in diagnostic helper:
1. Open the Antigravity window experiencing the issue.
2. Open the Command Palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P` on Windows/Linux or `Cmd+Shift+P` on macOS).
3. Select **`Antigravity Remote: Copy Diagnostics`**.
4. Paste the copied report in the code block below:

```text
<!-- Paste "Antigravity Remote: Copy Diagnostics" output here -->
<!-- Note: The diagnostic output is sanitized; it contains zero tokens, secrets, or chat titles -->
```
